title: Token Shield Fleet record v1
description: Frozen, versioned whitelist for one per-machine, per-day fleet record. scripts/fleet.py builds a record by walking THIS schema (via signals._project, a generic whitelist walker reused rather than copied) and copying only what it names, never by taking a larger internal object and deleting the bad parts. additionalProperties is false everywhere on purpose. Deliberately absent, per the design doc (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-token-shield-fleet-design.md): no prompts, no file contents, no repo names, no session transcripts, no user names. The one field this schema documents but the generic whitelist walk does not itself enforce is "experiments": a JSON-schema array node is a leaf-type check to the walker (it does not recurse into array items), so each experiment record is whitelisted at construction time in scripts/fleet.py's _day_experiments() instead; this node's "items" describes that contract for readers, it does not police it.

schema.description: Bumped whenever a field is added, removed, or reinterpreted. A reader (fleet.load_record) refuses a record whose schema is newer than it understands rather than guess.

date.description: Day resolution only, one record per machine per calendar day. Matches the YYYY-MM-DD component of the store path fleet/<org>/<machine-id>/<date>.json.

machine_id.description: sha256 hex digest of the machine's hostname plus the org's own salt (fleet.compute_machine_id). Never the raw hostname; the org chooses whether ids are readable (a memorable salt) or pseudonymous (a random one).

team.description: Free tag from the machine's local fleet config, for example "ios". Set by `fleet join` (F2); not yet populated by anything in this repo.

environment.description: Free tag from the machine's local fleet config, for example "ci". Set by `fleet join` (F2); not yet populated by anything in this repo.

counters.description: Token counters bucketed by model, per day. The local telemetry ledger (session_end_telemetry.py) carries a distinct MODEL COUNT per session, never model identity, so F1 has no honest basis for a true per-model split and buckets every day's counters under the single key "unknown" instead of guessing a name. Field names inside each bucket are copied verbatim from the transcript usage schema measure_tokens.py parses (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens), never the ledger's own renamed fields.

experiments.description: Labeled records exported from the local proof ledger (experiment.py's savings.jsonl), one entry per experiment that ended on this record's date. Whitelisted at construction time, not by this node (see the top-level description); this node exists to document the contract.

config_fingerprint.description: This machine's own config fingerprint at push time (experiment.compute_fingerprint), so drift is visible fleet-wide. Distinct from an individual experiment's fingerprint_start/end above.

token_shield_version.description: This machine's installed token-shield plugin version, for example "1.8.0". A non-conforming value (a dev, fork, or prerelease string) is omitted, never sent.
